title: Rockgeist Silver Spacelink
content:
The Spacelink by North Carolina-based Rockgeist allows you to easily attach both top tube and feed/stem bags to your bike by replacing a stem spacer on 1 1/8″ steerer bicycle forks. This comes in handy for feed bags, particularly on hardtail or mountain bike frames where a short, 35 mm stem doesn’t have enough purchase to have a velcro strap wrapped around it. After years of requests, the team at Rockgeist has finally made a silver Spacelink ($38), and they’re in stock for now at Rockgeist.

The post Rockgeist Silver Spacelink appeared first on The Radavist.
author: John Watson
